Transfer function matrices and MIMO interconnections

Source: R/physics-control-mimo.R
TransferFunctionMatrix.Rd

TransferFunctionMatrix(arg) is the transfer function matrix of a MIMO system, built from a list of rows of SISO systems. TransferFunctionMatrix$from_Matrix(matrix, var) builds one from a matrix of rational expressions. MIMOSeries(), MIMOParallel() and MIMOFeedback() are the interconnections of MIMO systems. A transfer function matrix has the properties $var, $num_inputs, $num_outputs and $shape and the methods $transpose(), $elem_poles(), $elem_zeros(), $eval_frequency(), $simplify() and $expand(); tfm[i, j] is an element or a submatrix. After sympy.physics.control.lti.

Usage

TransferFunctionMatrix(arg)

# S3 method for class 'TransferFunctionMatrix'
x[i, j, drop = TRUE]

MIMOSeries(..., evaluate = FALSE)

MIMOParallel(..., evaluate = FALSE)

MIMOFeedback(sys1, sys2, sign = -1L)

Arguments

arg

A list of rows of SISO systems.

x

A transfer function matrix.

i, j

The row and column indices.

drop

Whether a single element is returned as a SISO system.

...

The systems.

evaluate

Whether to evaluate the interconnection.

sys1, sys2

The systems of the feed forward and feedback paths.

sign

The sign of the feedback.

Value

A TransferFunctionMatrix, MIMOSeries, MIMOParallel or MIMOFeedback object.

Examples

s <- Symbol("s")
G1 <- TransferFunction(1, s + 1, s); G2 <- TransferFunction(s, s + 2, s)
M <- TransferFunctionMatrix(list(list(G1, G2), list(G2, G1)))
M$shape
#> (2, 2) 
MIMOSeries(M, M)$doit()
#> TransferFunctionMatrix(((TransferFunction(s^2*(s + 1)^2 + (s + 2)^2, (s + 1)^2*(s + 2)^2, s), TransferFunction(2*s*(s + 1)*(s + 2), (s + 1)^2*(s + 2)^2, s)), (TransferFunction(2*s*(s + 1)*(s + 2), (s + 1)^2*(s + 2)^2, s), TransferFunction(s^2*(s + 1)^2 + (s + 2)^2, (s + 1)^2*(s + 2)^2, s))))
